senses.gloss: a town in Southern Babylonia between the canals, seat of the college founded by Rab.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 67b">B. Mets. 67ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>משכנתא דס׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M02910"><he>מַשְׁכַּנְתָּא</he></cite>.
